# Stake APT with FP Validated

FP Validated runs an Aptos delegation pool. Anyone can add APT to the pool, and the pool stakes it with FP Validated's validator. Your share of the pool belongs to your own address.

## Before you start

- An Aptos wallet such as [Petra](https://petra.app).
- At least 10 APT to stake, plus a little extra for gas.

## Stake

1. Open your wallet's staking section, or the [FP Validated pool on the Aptos Explorer](https://explorer.aptoslabs.com/validator/0x48a7c513805eb2636d420879f26ec36ce9b22f7adcf32ef8f618058f80552696?network=mainnet) and connect your wallet there.
2. Confirm the delegation pool address matches the key facts table.
3. Enter the amount of APT and sign the transaction.

Your stake becomes active at the next epoch. Epochs last about 2 hours.

## Rewards

- Rewards are added to your stake every epoch and compound automatically. There is nothing to claim.
- Rewards depend on how many of its block proposals the validator completes successfully.
- Commission is taken from rewards, not principal.

## Unstake

1. In your wallet or the explorer, choose **Unlock** and enter the amount.
2. The unlocked APT stays pending until the pool's current 14-day lockup cycle ends. The explorer shows the time to the next unlock.
3. After the lockup ends, choose **Withdraw** to move the APT to your address.

Pending stake keeps earning rewards until the lockup cycle ends. You can reactivate it before then if you change your mind.

## Fees

- **Operator commission:** shown in the key facts table. A commission change takes effect from the next lockup cycle.
- **Add-stake fee:** when you stake partway through an epoch, a small fee is withheld so that new stake does not earn rewards for an epoch it was not active in.
- **Gas:** each transaction costs a small amount of APT.

## Risks

- **No slashing.** The Aptos framework does not slash stake.
- **Performance risk.** Missed or failed block proposals reduce rewards for the whole pool.
- **Lockup.** Unlocked APT is not available until the end of the current 14-day lockup cycle.

See [Responsiveness and Slashing Policy](/fp-validated-infra/responsiveness-and-slashing-policy) for how FP Validated responds to incidents.

## Institutional staking

Institutions can stake APT from custody platforms that support Aptos delegation pools. Contact FP Validated to confirm that our pool is available on your custodian.

## FAQ

**Do I need to claim rewards?**
No. Rewards compound into your stake every epoch.

**Why is the minimum 10 APT?**
The delegation pool contract requires at least 10 APT per delegation so that pool share prices stay accurate.

**How long does unstaking take?**
Until the end of the current 14-day lockup cycle, so anywhere from a few hours to 14 days.
